points.en: GATT was a multilateral treaty signed in 1947 to regulate international trade.
points.hi: GATT was a multilateral treaty signed in 1947 to regulate international trade.

points.en: Objective: Reduce tariffs and other trade barriers to promote global economic recovery post-WWII.
points.hi: Objective: Reduce tariffs and other trade barriers to promote global economic recovery post-WWII.

points.en: It functioned as a provisional agreement until the establishment of the WTO in 1995.
points.hi: It functioned as a provisional agreement until the establishment of the WTO in 1995.

points.en: Key Principle: Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) treatment, ensuring non-discrimination among trading partners.
points.hi: Key Principle: Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) treatment, ensuring non-discrimination among trading partners.

meaning.en: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
meaning.hi: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

explanation.en: A framework for trade liberalization that preceded the World Trade Organization.
explanation.hi: A framework for trade liberalization that preceded the World Trade Organization.

question.en: When was GATT replaced by the WTO?
question.hi: When was GATT replaced by the WTO?

answer.en: GATT was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) on January 1, 1995, following the Uruguay Round.
answer.hi: GATT was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) on January 1, 1995, following the Uruguay Round.

misconception.en: GATT was a formal international organization.
misconception.hi: GATT was a formal international organization.

correction.en: GATT was a multilateral treaty, not an organization; the WTO is the formal organization.
correction.hi: GATT was a multilateral treaty, not an organization; the WTO is the formal organization.

fiveFacts.en: Focused primarily on trade in goods.
fiveFacts.hi: Focused primarily on trade in goods.

fiveFacts.en: Uruguay Round (1986–1994) led to the creation of the WTO.

threeTraps.en: Assuming GATT covered services (it focused on goods).
threeTraps.hi: Assuming GATT covered services (it focused on goods).

threeTraps.en: Confusing GATT with the Bretton Woods institutions (IMF/World Bank).

meaning.en: GATT primarily dealt with trade in goods, unlike the WTO which expanded to services (GATS) and intellectual property (TRIPS).
